verdict.rationale: Airwallex offers a full REST API with server-side SDKs, an official CLI for scripting from the command line, scoped API keys, webhooks, and a sandbox environment—all of which support headless/CI automation of financial operations (transfers, batch transfers, card issuing, FX). This is reinforced by AgentOS and developer connectors explicitly built for programmatic/agentic use against production or sandbox accounts. Missing for 10: no explicit CI pipeline examples (e.g., GitHub Actions integration) or independent hands-on confirmation of CLI use in automated pipelines.
